function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH chan AS (
  SELECT sl.period, c.channel, SUM(sl.revenue_cad) AS revenue, SUM(sl.qty) AS qty
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
  GROUP BY sl.period, c.channel
)
SELECT period,
       channel,
       revenue,
       qty,
       SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY period) AS total_revenue_period,
       SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY period) AS total_qty_period,
       revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY period) AS revenue_share,
       qty / SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY period) AS qty_share
FROM chan
ORDER BY period, channel","purpose":"Channel revenue and quantity shares for Aug and Sep 2026"}
